source_method: Raw GLB POSITION/indices/TEXCOORD_0, no node transforms, skins, joints, IBM, COLOR_0 or animation.

material.note: Controlled diffuse preview; not a recreation of Unreal or Minecraft renderer shading.

camera_policy: Source-only bounds, unchanged origin/scale; same camera and world lights reused per pair. No independent reframing.
mask_policy: Visible alpha mask: rendered coverage alpha >= 128/255 after source texture alpha > cutoff. Object mask: same geometry made opaque. No dilation, alignment, cropping or rescaling.
